title: Price history charts
changes: Added a gold-accented historical price chart below the buy and sell prices for tradeable items.
Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, 1 year and all available history, with price and volume statistics.
Kept charts out of floating windows so their compact price cards remain easy to use.

title: Price checker redesign and floating-window fixes
changes: Refreshed the item and boss price checker cards with a clearer amber-accented layout, search controls and scrolling results.
Improved floating-window dragging, including a correctly sized drag preview and viewport clamping.
Improved boss-window resizing, scrollable unique-drop lists, and floating-window close controls and saved positions.
